name: metatable-delegation
source:
local writes=0
local backing={value=42}
local proxy=setmetatable({}, {__index=backing,__newindex=function(_,key,value) writes+=1 rawset(backing,key,value) end})
proxy.value=43
assert(backing.value==43 and writes==1)
rawset(proxy,"value",44)
proxy.value=45
assert(proxy.value==45 and writes==1 and backing.value==43)
print("metatable-ok")

name: metatable-equality
source:
local meta={__eq=function(a,b) return a.id==b.id end}
local a=setmetatable({id=7},meta)
local b=setmetatable({id=7},meta)
assert(a==b and not rawequal(a,b))
print("equal")

name: custom-iteration
source:
local proxy=setmetatable({}, {__iter=function() return next,{answer=42},nil end})
local count=0
for _,value in proxy do count+=value end
assert(count==42)
print(count)

name: contextual-continue
source:
local count=0
for _,value in {1,2,3} do if value==2 then continue end count+=value end
print(count)
